demo.program:
# PureScript — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Who created PureScript?", "Phil Freeman"),
    ("What paradigm is PureScript?", "functional"),
    ("What is creator?", "Phil Freeman"),
    ("What is first appeared?", "2013"),
    ("What is paradigm?", "functional"),
    ("What is typing?", "static"),
    ("What is file extension?", ".purs"),
    ("What is hello world?", "log \"Hello, world!\""),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
